reviews.text:
We’ve been coming to Mon Joli Chien for ages now, and it has become a place we genuinely trust with our Pomeranian.

Pomeranians can be quite tricky to groom — not only because of their double coat, but also because they can be prone to alopecia and coat damage if groomed incorrectly. It was therefore really important for us to find groomers who have experience with the breed and genuinely know what they’re doing.

We’ve only ever had positive experiences with Mon Joli Chien and can’t recommend them enough! The staff are always incredibly friendly, helpful and professional.

Our dog isn’t exactly the easiest customer either 😂 He can be quite boisterous at times and occasionally misbehaves during grooming, but somehow they manage to groom him to perfection every single time. He always comes back looking absolutely amazing!

Great grooming, great people, and a place we completely trust with our little Pom.
My husband and I love how our fluffy one, Poki, is groomed. The groomers are very professional, and the results look amazing. 🧡
Super friendly staff and great quick service for a nail clipping. We’ll be back!
Took my toy poodle in and although they always do a great job at MJC whoever cut his hair on Monday did an amazing job . Looks fab. :)
Nice grooming salon with a welcoming staff.
Great service and very professional. They made my little Cavalier look beautiful! Thank you
Highly recommended - the staff couldn’t be nicer or more helpful, and they clearly all love dogs and know how to make them feel at ease. And they do great grooming too!
Thank you so much for taking the time to review us 💕 …

Loved the groom my dog received from the team (and I am fussy and hard to please!). It’s the best groom and experience she has had in the Islington area. We will be repeat customers and would recommend to friends.
